tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo'i mngon dkyil gsang chen myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo badzra dhā ra ya/ 'dir paṇa chen nā ro'i brgyud 'dzin tshes bcu sogs dus bzang gi mchod pa la spro ba'i skal ldan dam tshig can mchog dngos grub pa'i go 'phang thob 'dod dag gis/ dben pa'i gnas su stegs kyi khar dkyil 'khor ras bris bkram zhing*/ dbang rdzas rnams dang nang mchod/ gzhan yang mchod pa dang gtor ma la sogs pa gang 'byor dang*/ khyad par thabs shes tshogs kyi yo byad sna tshogs pa gtsang zhing bzang ba lag len mthong rgyun ltar dang*/ ḍā dril sogs 'du bgyid la/ zhal nub tu phyogs bzhin/ dang po/ rang nyid skad cig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rgyan dang cha lugs yongs rdzogs gsal bar gyur// de nas nang mchod byin rlabs bsangs sbyangs ni/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shu ddho3haṃ/ stong par gyur pa'i ngang las yam̐ ram̐ kam̐// rlung me thod sgyed de steng a las thod// sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang sa bon mtshan// 'od zer 'phro 'dus ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma'ang gong ltar byin brlabs nas/ gtor mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing*/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ pad skor rdor thal kha phye bas/ oṃ badzra ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya st+waṃ dṛ shya hoḥ lan gsum dang*/ pad skor rdor thal kha phye bas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa bhu ta pre ta pi sha tsa ubda da a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i daṃ ba ling gṛ hnantu sa ma ya rakṣantu ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu ya thai baṃ ya thaiṣṭaṃḥbhūñdza tha dzi gha tha pi ba tha ma ti pra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sata su khaṃ bi shuddha ye/ sā hā yi ka bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan bzhi brjod/ zhing skyong brgyad dang mkha' 'gro so gnyis sogs// 'khor bcas mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams phyir dengs shig

/ gtor ma phyi rol phul/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇā gṛhṇā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhnā pa ya gṛhnā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bgegs bskrad la/ rdo rje'i srung 'khor phyogs bcur 'bar ba dang*// sgo mtshams lha mo rnams kyis bar chad bzlog /oṃ badzra wā rā hī hriḥgha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ gnod byed sarba duṣṭān hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes mtshams bcad/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥbighnan gyi sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la// yangs pa'i snod rnams nang du hūm̐ yig tshogs// 'od zhu kun bzang rnam thar las lhag pa'i// mchod sprin rgya mtsho nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur// oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badzra puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai bi dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyabs sems ni/ na mo/ bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum lhar// skyabs su mchi'o 'gro ba'i don// byang chub bar du sems bskyed do// gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig brjod/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang gi lte ba'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas// rnal 'byor ma dpal 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur// padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ zhes gdan 'bul dang*/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni na mo/ zhes phyag 'tshal/ sarba pū dza pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ ratna maṇḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod pa phul/ rdo rje 'chang chen dpal ldan 'khor lo'i mgon// rtsa ba brgyud bcas yi dam lha rab 'byams// ye shes chos skyong bka' srung rgya mtsho la// gsol 'debs bdag rgyud smin grol byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab/ tshogs zhing 'od zhu rang thim dbyer med gyur/ de nas bdag bskyed kyi rim pa la/ tshad med bsgom pa/ 'gro ba sems can bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// dga' dang ldan zhing btang snyoms gnas gyur cig

/oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ gzung 'dzin chos kun stong pa'i ngang nyid las// e las chos 'byung gru gsum gzhal yas khang*// phyi dkar nang dmar dbus su gdan padma// ro dang nyi steng rang rig bum mdun skabs yi ge zhes kha bsgyur dgos/ hrīḥdamar po// 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas nas rnal 'byor ma// mdog dmar 'od kyis stong gsum kun khyab gsal// chos sku nyag gcig zhal la dus gsum gzigs// spyan gsum bdud 'joms khro gnyer zhal aṃ gtsigs// dbu skra kham nag 'bar bar rigs lnga mtshon// thod skam dbu rgyan thabs shes phyag gnyis kyis// gri gug thod khrag rol zhing 'gying ba'i tshul// thabs kyi kha ṭwām̐ dkur brten bcu drug gi// lang tsho sgeg pa'i dkar 'dzin chu 'dzin rgyas// phyin drug rang bzhin rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga// dril g.yer rgyan dang 'du byed dag pa'i brdar// mgo rlon do shal me tog dmar po'i phreng*// mtha' gnyis mi gnas g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang zhabs// dpa' mo rol pa'i gar stabs dang bcas bzhugs// gnas bzhir ha ri ni sa'i yi ge las// mkha' 'gro sngo ser dmar ljang rdo rje dang*// rin chen padma ral gris mtshan gri gug /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ dkur brten rang 'dra'i 'khor// rim bzhin so gnyis bcu drug brgyad drug cu// rtsa bzhis bskor zhing gtso mo'i gsang gnas su// chos 'byung bsnol dbus hrīḥdang mkha' 'gro bzhi// so so'i sa bon 'od kyis o rgyan nas// rnal 'byor ma tshogs mdun mkhar spyan drangs gyur// badzra sa mā dzaḥ de rnams sku las sku 'phros gsung las sngags// thugs las byang sems rgyun babs gsang gsum byin// bde stong ting 'dzin ye shes rgyud la smin// lha rnams rang rang skur thim gnyis med ngang*// rnam snang he ru ka yis rgyas gdab gyur// de nas bsnyen dmigs don kun grub pa'i 'khor lo ni/ gsang bar chos 'byung padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus// hrīḥmathar sngags phreng g.yon 'khor phyogs 'dab bzhir// ha ri ni sas mtshan pa'i 'od spro bsdus// 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i don byas rang thim gyur// oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

ci nus bzla'o// mthar thun bsdu rdzogs rim ni/ phyi nang snod bcud 'khor rnams rang la 'dus// de yang 'od zhu hrīḥr thim thig le dang*// nā da las 'das don dam stong nyid ngang*// ci gnas su bzhag /de nas/ slar yang rnal 'byor ma ru lam gyis gsal// ces thun mtshams la 'jug /lag mchod bya ba ni/ bdud rtsi bsangs ba dang*/ lag gnyis kyang bsangs la/ oṃ āḥbighnān sogs dang*/ mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pā lar// a mṛ ta bzhis bkang dbus dang*/ lag g.yon mthil bcas so so la// oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod la g.yon du zlum skor dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis chos 'byung bri/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ hrīḥha ri ni sa thig le lnga bkod/ chos 'byung pad 'dab bzhi ldan dbus// yi ge lnga yi 'od spro bsdus// don gnyis byas te lha lngar gyur// sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐/ shrī badzra yo gi ni na mo/ slar yang 'od 'phros dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// mdun mkhar ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs gyur// badzra sarba pū dza ho/ oṃ na mo na ma hūm̐/ nam mkha'i lha rnams lag pa'i lhar 'dus nas// chang nang lhar thim ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi 'thor bzhin/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni sogs brjod/ srung dang bzlog pa'i mkha' 'gro'i drwa gur gtams/ /rang la 'thor zhing sngags brjod/ lus kyi ba spu'i grangs mnyam mkha' 'gros khengs// tshogs dang mchod rdzas la 'thor sngags brjod/ gnas dang yo byad dag pa chen por bsgyur// bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam chos skyong dang*/ 'gro kun lhar gsal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi 'bul zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gis kyang myong*/ de nas bum bskyed ni/ bdud rtsi 'thor la/ oṃ āḥbighnān gyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las bhrūm̐ yig yongs gyur rin po che'i// bum bzang dmar po mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs// lha yi dar dang tsu ta'i yal gas brgyan// nyer lnga'i rdzas gtams bdud rtsi'i chus gang dbus// e las chos 'byung gru gsum

sogs bdag bskyed ltar/ gar stabs dang bcas bzhugs// bar dang*/ phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa yongs gyur las// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro rang mdog gri thod dang*// kha ṭwāṃ dkur brten gtso mo'i gsang gnas hrīḥ /'khor bzhi'i sa bon 'od 'phros o rgyan nas// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs spyan drangs pa'i// sbyor mtshams byang sems dkar dmar rgyun 'babs pas// me long thod pa bum dkyil dbyer med gyur// bar dmigs la sngags bzla'o/ mthar/ dkyil 'khor gsum khengs bum lha 'od zhur gyur// de nas mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ras bris bdud rtsis bsangs/ stong las mdun mkhar chos 'byung gzhal yas khang*// sogs bdag bskyed ltar dang*/ gar stabs dang bcas bzhugs// bar dang*/ phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa yongs gyur las// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro rang mdog gri thod dang*// kha ṭwām̐ dkur brten gtso mo'i gsang gnas hrīḥ 'khor bzhi'i sa bon 'od 'phros o rgyan nas// gtso 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs gyur// badzra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ chos dbyings spros bral bde chen 'dus ma byas// rang snang ma 'gags bka' brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dpal tshogs// ye shes chos skyong 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// oṃ e ā ralli hoḥ badzra wā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ dy-i shya ho/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes spyan drangs la/ padma ka ma la ya st+waṃ/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hi badzra arghaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai bi dye/ shabda pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐/ pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ nang mchod phul ba dang*/ 'khyud rgya byas la/ mā taṅgi āḥhūm̐/ de rnams sku las sku 'phros sogs bdag bskyed bzhin dang*/ rgyas gdab gyur/ bar/ mdun bskyed la dmigs te bzlas pa bya/ de nas bstod pa ni/ bde stong zung 'jug lhan skyes sku// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma// dus gsum rgyal rnams bskyed pa'i gzhi// rdo rje btsun mor phyag 'tshal bstod//

phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams 'bul ba ni/ yan lag brgyad ldan yid 'ong mchod yon dang*// chu dang thang skyes lha yi me tog tshal// spos ngad ldang ba'i sprin chen drwa ba mdzes// snang gsal nyi zla'i rang bzhin cir yang 'tsher// dri chab bsung zhim rlabs phreng chal chil g.yo// ro brgya ldan pa'i bshos gtsang tshar du dngar// rgyud mangs rol mo'i bye brag srid gsum ldir// rnal 'byor ma mchog 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// so so'i sngags rgya dang bcas/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabda/ bar sngar bzhin 'gre'o/ /rdo rje'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// sha chen gsur dud zhun me byang sems rgyun// rdo rje dri chen dri chu cang te'u// myos byed bzhi ldan dam rdzas a mṛ ta// mtshan bzang bde skyong ka pā lar gtams nas// thabs shes dbyer med ngang du mchod bzhes rol// bla med grub mchog ye shes dngos kun stsol// badzra wā rā hī oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra= ratna= padma= karma= bi shwa= lo ka ḍā ki nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs kyis nang mchod 'bul ba dang*/ bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam chos skyong dang*// 'gro kun lhar gsal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bul/ de nas dbang len par spro na/ las bum gyis khrus byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ maṇḍal la pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ gis maṇḍal dang gsol gdab ni/ bdag ni 'khor bar skyo zhing thar pa'i lam// 'jug 'dod lags na dam pas rjes 'dzin gsol// 'di rigs lan gsum mam gcig bya/ dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu// bdag la dam tshig de nyid dang*// byang chub sems dang skyabs gsum stsol// mgon pos thar pa'i grong gzhug 'tshal//

lan gsum/ rgyun bshags ni/ mchog gsum skyabs mchi sdig kun bshags// dge la yi rang byang sems bzung*// gzhan phan sems bskyed 'gro don gnyer// byang chub spyod bzhin sangs rgyas shog / lan gsum/ slob ma lhar gsal gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dri'i theg le bya/ lte ba snying ga kha dang mgo spyi gtsug smin mtshams rnams su rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo gnyis gshibs te brkyang ba rdo rje'i rgyas so sor reg la/ oṃ bam̐/ haṃ yaṃ/ hrīṃ maṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ go cha'i dpa' mos gnas rnams bsrung par gyur// oṃ tsakṣu bhandha bā ra mā ṇa ye hūm̐/ gdong dar bcings/ oṃ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ me tog byin/ sngar ltar zhing skyong dang mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma btang*/ srung 'khor dang mtshams bcad/ snying khar zla dkyil rdo rje rtse lngas mtshan// oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa dā yā mi/ lan gsum/ rdo rje snying khar bzhag la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ ho/ siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ de nyid brtan par mos/ rgyal ba sras bcas dpa' bo dang*// rnal 'byor ma rnams bdag la dgongs// rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi// sdom pa dam tshig so sor bzung*// lan gsum/ mgo bor rdo rje bzhag / deng khyod rdo rje gsang ba che'i// bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub par gyis// dam chu btung*/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī a mṛ to da ka ṭha/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i ched du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dpa' bo rnal 'byor tshogs// ye shes bdag rgyud smin par byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ skyil krung phyed lang spyi bor chos 'byung gi rgya byas la/ rlung dkyil steng du rang nyid rje btsun mar// gsal ba'i lte bar chos 'byung 'bar dbus hrīḥ /sngags phreng drag 'khor 'od kyis mdun dkyil dang*// o rgyan gnas nas ye shes spyan drangs thim// gu gul dang tshil chen bsreg /ḍā ma ru bkrol zhing*/

oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa ā we sha ya ā we sha ya/ a āḥhrīḥhrīḥhrīḥpheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ ngo sprad rdo rje'i glu ni/ snang ba sna tshogs cho 'phrul rnams// rang sems bde chen ye shes rtsal// lhan skyes spros bral chos sku'i mdangs// gnyug ma'i ngo bor mngon du gsal// ye shes brtan pa'i phyir mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ tiṣṭha badzra/ dkyil 'khor du me tog dor la/ badzra ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha badzra ho/ zhes brjod/ bcom ldan 'das mas rjes bzung mdzod// me tog de nyid spyi bor bkod la/

oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ mig dar bsal/ lha ngo sprad pa ni/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar gyur// dbang dngos gzhi'i don du/ oṃ maṇḍal la pū dza sogs dang*/ gsol gdab ni/ lha tshogs rnams kyis zag med ye shes mchog /dbang bzhi'i chu bo'i smin byed stsal du gsol// lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ dbang rdzas rnams thogs la/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis// rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad// bum thod bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur cod pan bcings// rdo rje dang ni dril bu ming dbang bskur// mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan gtad nas su// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dbang thob nas// dug lnga rnam dag ye shes lnga mngon gyur// rigs lngas rgyas gdab bum dbang thob bskyed rim// snang stong dbyer med bsgom dbang sprul sku 'grub// gsang dbang ni/ rnal 'byor ma dang sdom pa mnyam sbyor gyi// byang sems bdud rtsi'i gsang ba'i dbang bskur ro// thod pa'i bdud rtsi btung*/ rtsa 'khor bzhi brgyud bde bas khyab rdzogs rim// gsal stong bsgom dbang longs sku 'grub par gyur// sher dbang ni/ me long sindhū ra lte bar bzhag nas/ me long dal las rnal 'byor ma 'phros nas// lte bar zhugs pas tsaṇḍa'i me 'bar bas// haṃ zhu rtsa 'khor bzhi brgyud dga' bzhi myong*// 'od gsal bsgom dbang chos sku 'grub par gyur// dbang bzhi pa ni/ sems nyid gzhi rtsa bral ba phyag rgya che// snang sems gnyis med chos skur shes par gyis// sgo gsum sgrib dag rig stong lhan cig skyes// bsgom par dbang zhing ngo bo nyid sku 'grub// slob dpon dbang ni/ slob ma rdor 'chang snyems ma yab yum sbyor// gsal bar dbang lhas khrus gsol dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ lha rnams rang thim mi bskyod dbu brgyan gyur//

rdor dril 'dzin la/ thabs shes rdor dril thugs gsung sku'i dam tshig / de nas 'khyud rgya bcas/ brtan cing 'jig rten las 'das slob dpon dbang*// sindhū ra spyi bor byugs la/ bla ma'i spyi bor bsgom zhing rtag tu bsten// lte bar yang byugs/ phreng ba gtad la/ oṃ badzra bai ro sogs lan gsum bzla/ mgrin par byugs/ dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ phyi nang rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams// bsrung zhing phrin las rab 'byams bsgrub par byos// zhes bsgo/ slob mas/ bka' stsal dang len deng nas bdag bran 'bul// zhes zhu'o// de nas/ oṃ maṇḍal pū dza sogs kyis gtang rag phul/ tshogs rdzas rnams gong gi 'dud rtsi ltar byin brlab nas/ na mo/ thabs shes gnyis med tshogs 'khor lo// rang bzhin rnam dag skye med ngo bo ni// ā li kā li mtshan nyid rnam dag pa// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi mchod sprin gyur// spyan drangs pa ni/ gnas 'og min chos dbyings kyi pho brang nas// pha bka' brgyud bla ma rnams 'dir gshegs gsol// gnas bde chen mkha' spyod kyi zhing khams nas// ma rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro'i tshogs sku bzhengs shig /gnas rab 'jigs dur khrod kyi gnas brgyad nas// chos skyong ba'i bka' srung rnams sku bskyod 'tshal// 'dod yon tshogs zag med kyi rang bzhin la// dgyes par rol snod bcud kun byin gyis rlobs// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes tshogs phud gtor ma'i nang blugs nas bdud rtsi bran la dkyil 'khor par 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma lnga po/ oṃ āḥbighnān sogs byin rlabs sngar ltar dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum dang*/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ gtor mgron du rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs spyan drangs shing*/ pad kor thal mo kha phye ba dang*/ mthar se gol brdeb cing*/ oṃ badzra ā ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ dṛ shya hoḥ

lan gsum/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa i daṃ ba liṃ pū dza khā hi khā hi gṛ hṇa ma ma rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum dang*/ badzra ḍā ki nī/ de bzhin du/ buddha/ ratna/ padma/ karma/ bi shwa/ lo ka ḍā ki nī i daṃ ba ling sogs gong ltar lan gsum/ ljags hūm̐ rdo rje dmar po'i 'od sbu gus// bdud rtsi gtor ma gsol bas mnyes par gyur// oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ mā taṅgi āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ badzra wā rā hī na mo hūm̐/ zhing skyong ba sogs la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi sogs lan bzhi dang*/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ haṃ haṃ he he hi hi pheṃ pheṃ/ gsum gyis las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams la 'bul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// yid la 'dod pa'i don kun mdzod// phrin las bcol/ chos skyong la/ dpal ldan rdo rje nag po che// lcam dral bka' 'khor srung ma'i tshogs// mchod gtor 'di bzhes rnal 'byor skyong*// phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// ces phul/ de nas tshogs la rol/ phud lhag phyogs gcig tu bsdus la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis byin brlab/ hūm̐/ las dang 'jig rten ḍā ki ma// sha za mkha' 'gro yang 'khor bcas// phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes// bstan srung rnal 'byor bar chad zlog /oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba lyīṃ bhakṣa bhakṣasī swā hā/ phyi rol dor/ de nas rjes kyi mchod pa ni/ oṃ shrī badzra wā ra hī sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ/ nas/ shabda 'i bar dang*/ pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ ma taṅgi āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod/ bde stong bla ma yid bzhin gyi// nor bu gtsug gi rgyan ldan ma// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yum gyur ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// yi ge brgya pas chad lhag kha bskang*/ bzod par gsol nas 'dod don gsol ba ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang mchog tu tshad ma ste// bden pa de yis lha mo mchog gis ni// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// skyon med kyai yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i shu kra mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad sdig med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi// sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad par shog /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// da lta nyid du rjes brtse bas// rnal 'byor bstan bcos gnas la dgod// ces smon lam btab bo// rten yod na/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swā hā/ brjod la me tog gtor zhing brtan bzhugs bya'o// de min/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ bkra shis ni/ byin rlabs gter chen bka' brgyud kyi// bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis gang*// phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs shog /dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis gang*// mchog thun gnyis kyis rgyud smin shog /phrin las kun bdag rdo rje ber// bstan srung tshogs kyi bkra shis gang*// phyi nang bar chad zhi gyur cig / ces me tog 'thor zhing*/ sarba bhū ta gatstsha/ se gol brdeb cing*/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas gshegs/ dkon mchog rin chen gsum la sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam dkyus mthun brjod cing gsang sngags gsang ba'i phyir rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar bdag bskyed rkyang pa sngon 'gro bzhi rim sogs la sbyar ba'am/ rgyun gyi nyams len lta bur yang khyer bde snyam zhing sgrub pa'i mchod pa'am/ dus kyi mchod pa dang 'brel ba'i skabs gzhung mthar chags su bton pa dang*/ tshogs brgya btang skabs kyang de dang mtshungs shing*/ bsdus par na bdag skyed bsnyen pa bsdu rim zin nas/

tshogs byin rlabs mchod pa kho nas grangs 'dzin pa bcas gang bder bya'o// de ltar dad dang dam tshig rnam dag rgyal yum dam pa gang de'i bzhed ngor/ si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos bsdus pa'i tshul gyis mngon dkyil tshigs su bcad pa bkod pa la nongs pa gang mchis rtsa gsum lha la bshags shing*/ dge ba 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ sngon 'gro gtor ma bshams nas/ bdud rtsi lnga'i chus bsangs shing*/ oṃ āḥbighnanta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can chang zung la yam̐ dang*/ mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las thod pa bum ril gyi sgyed pu ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum gyi steng du/ yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su mu las dri chu bai ḍūrya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rakta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba glang gi sha /lho nub du ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta'i sha /de rnams slar yang yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o// rang gi sna phug g.yon pa nas rlung hūm̐ gi dbyibs can 'phros/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog /ba dan bskyod pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug

dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing*/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes gtor mgron spyan drangs/ pad skor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ badzra ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥbadzra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya ho/ zhes lan gsum mam bzhi 'am lngar brjod/ so so'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= nai wi dya= shabda aḥhūm̐ swā hā/ pad skor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsa ubda da a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i damba liṃ gṛhnantu sa ma ya rakṣantu ma ma siddhi mme pra yatstshantu ya thi baṃ ya thi bhaṃḥbhuñdza tha dzi ghra tha pi pa tha ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sata su khaṃ bi shuddha ye/ sā hā yi ka bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan bzhir brjod/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams dang*// mkha' 'gro sum cu so gnyis sogs// ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir byon zhing*// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// gang dag nag po'i phyogs gyur cing*// gsang sngags zab mo'i cho ga la// nyan dang lta bar mi dbang ba// de dag thams cad gzhan du dengs// gal te bka' las 'da' byed na// rdo rje kha ṭāṃ rab 'bar bas// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas 'gyur//

gtor ma phyi rol du dor zhing*/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛ hṇā pa ya gṛ hnā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bidya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i drwa ba dang*/ gur bla bres su gyur/ hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la seng gdong ma// badzra sidha zhes bya ba// steng sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra man rdo rje'i dus la bab// steng gi bar chad bzlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo= /lha mo'i lus la khā gdong ma// badzra kā ka= /shar sgo= dzaḥphra men= /shar gyi= hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo= /lha mo'i lus la 'ug gdong ma// badzra utgu= /byang sgo= /dzaḥphra men= /byang gi= /hūm̐ 'di ltar= /lha mo'i lus la khyi gdong ma// badzra shwa na= /nub sgo= dzaḥphra men= /nub kyi= /hūm̐ 'di ltar= /lha mo'i lus la phag gdong ma/ badzra pu ka= /lho sgo= /dzaḥphra men= /lho yi= /hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo= /lha mo'i lus la stag gdong ma// badzra bya ghri= /'og sgo= /dza phra men= /'og gi bar chad bzlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar= /sgo ma rnams kyi sgo srung la// mtshams ma rnams kyis mtshams sdoms shig /phyi nang bar chad bzlog tu gsol// oṃ badzra wā rā hī hrīḥ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ gnod byed sarba du3lt;?>ཾ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes mtshams bcad do/// / ༈ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang bskur bde chen lam gyi snang byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo shrī badzra yo gi nī ye/ 'dir yi dam lhan cig skyes ma'i sgo nas skal ldan gyi slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i rim pa la/ dkyil 'khor dbang rdzas mchod pa sogs mthong brgyud bzhin byas la/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs nas brtsams te bdag bskyed/ bum bskyed/ mdun bskyed/

mchod bstod/ bdag 'jug /tshogs dang bcas pa grub nas dbang gi sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi stan thog gcig tu bskur ba la/ zung du ma gyur pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas nas dbyung*/ maṇḍal bkye bsdu byas la/ 'o na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la mngon du gzhag par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo smin byed dbang gi rim pa la 'jug pa bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed dang ldan pas legs par gsan 'tshal/ de'ang dal ba brgyad/ 'byor ba bcu dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di lta bu thob pa'i skabs 'dir don med snyom las kyi dbang du btang na/ nam zhig mi rtag 'chi ba'i dus la bab tshe las dkar nag gi rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba so sor smin par 'gyur/ de bas na srid pa'i bde ba thams cad la dug can gyi zas bzhin spang byar shes nas thar pa dam pa'i chos la 'jug par bya ba gal che la/ de la theg pa'i 'jug sgo bsam gyis mi khyab kyang khyad par 'phags pa bla med rdo rje theg pa/ de yang nang gses su rgyud sde bzhir bzhugs pa las 'dir skabs su babs pa'i chos ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang*/ de'i yang snying por gyur pa rnal 'byor ma rgyud thams cad kyi yang snying dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gsang ba yum gyi sgrub thabs dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum gyur bcom ldan 'das lhan cig skyes ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba yin te/ de yang rdo rje theg pa'i lam las mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i lha'i gtso bo ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid yin te/ don gyi dbang du byas na lha yab yum la bzang ngan med kyang dag bya dag byed kyi dbang du byas na shes rab rtsa ba dang*/ thabs yan lag yin pa dang*/ bde ba chen po yang rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pas bsgrub dgos pas/

bdag nyid he ru ka'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral yang pho nya mo rnams bdag nyid rdo rje slob dpon du 'gyur ba'i phyir na mchog 'dod pa rnams kyi lhag pa'i lha'i gtso bo ni/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid yin cing*/ de la yang*/ don gyi phag mo ni chos kyi dbyings bsam mi khyab cing gzhal du med pa nam mkha' ltar kun la khyab cing rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin can dang*/ brda' yi phag mo ni/ e yig mkha' khams bha gar ni// zhes dang*/ rnal 'byor ma nyid sngags kyi gzugs// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lha sngags gnyis su med pa'i zung 'jug gi rnam par snang ba dang*/ rtags kyi phag mo ni longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gzugs su snang ba'i mos pa lam byed kyi yul du rung ba/ sku'i rnam pa rgyan cha lugs dang bcas pa ste/ de lta bu'i lha'i sgrub thabs kyi bka' srol rgyud gtso bor byas pa la/ phag mo zhal bzhi ma'i rgyud mngon par byang chub pa brtag pa brgyad pa dang*/ phag mo mngon 'byung snga phyi dang rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa zhes mai tri mkha' spyod ma'i rgyud chung ngu dang*/ phyogs mthun rnal 'byor ma kun spyod dang*/ kha sbyor gyi rgyud brtag pa bdun pa ste de dag gi man ngag zung du bkol ba phag mo gzhung drug dang*/ mkha' spyod ma'i rigs dang*/ rin chen rgyan drug sogs ches mang po grub pa'i slob dpon sa ra ha dang*/ klu sgrub dang*/ lū hi pa dang*/ dza landha ra/ nag po zhabs/ sha ba ri pa sogs kyis spyan drangs/ rgya che dar bar gyur la/ lam de dag la brten nas grub pa thob pa nyi zer gyi rdul tsam byung ba'i nang nas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tai lo shes rab bzang po zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar grags pa de nyid kyis bka' babs kyi bla ma spyi la brgyud nas man ngag mtha' dag gsan tshul mdzad la/ nges don du tai lo nga la mi yi bla ma med// nga yi bla ma thams cad mkhyen// ces gsungs pa ltar o rgyan dang*/

'og min du dngos su byon pa rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde man ngag mtha' dag rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ rdo rje 'chang dngos la gsan pa'i rgyud bshad dbang dang bcas pa gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen nā ro dzñā na siddhi la bka' chen bcu gnyis spyad pa'i mthar bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang zhing*/ slob dpon de nyid kyis mar ston chos kyi blo gros rjes su bzung nas rgyud sde mtha' dag gi dbang dang man ngag rdzogs par gnang ba yin la/ khyad par man ngag gtso bor byas pa'i lhan skyes rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs kun dang thun mong ma yin pa/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub lo zla tsam gyis thob par byed pa'i man ngag zab mo khyad par du 'phags pa 'di nyid kyi bskyed rim lhan cig skyes ma dang*/ rdzogs rim rlung sems gnyis med kyi man ngag sogs zhus shing rje btsun mas dngos su byin gyis brlabs par dgongs te nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ da ste zhag bdun nas dgun gyi nyi ma ldog /de nas mar ngo'i tshes bcu la dur khrod chen po so sa gling du tshogs kyi 'khor lo la song shig dang rje btsun mas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro gsungs te rang gi rgyal tshab tu kha ba can 'dul bar mnga' gsol/ bu seng ge khyung gi phru gu bzhin// slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*// zhes lung bstan pa ltar dur khrod der byon nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad nas gsol ba btab pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mi mo'i rnam pa can dang mjal zhing*/ shel gyi gri gug gis rnal 'byor ma nyid kyi thugs ka phyes pa'i nang nas rje btsun ma lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang aṣṭa sogs kyi 'khor lo bstan/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mdzad pa yin te/ rje nyid kyi rdo rje'i mgur las/ yum lhan cig skyes ma'i thugs ka nas// aṣṭa sngags kyi 'khor lo de// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// dbyibs sku yis ma bsgrib gsal bar mthong*// ltas mo ngo mtshar de che mod// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// rje btsun mas khyed rang rdo rje gdan du bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs rjes dang tshems mche ba bzhugs pa rnams mjal bar song dang don chen po yod gsungs pa ltar byon pas bse'i sgrom bu gcig gi nang nas dngul gyi gwa'u gcig byung*/

de'i nang nas shel gyi gwa'u zhig byung ba'i nang nas tshems mche ba g.yas dang*/ sngar med pa'i shing ta la'i byang bu la li khris bris pa'i yi ge dar dmar pos dril ba rnyed pa la mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas yi ge de nyid gdan drangs pa paṇḍi ta rnams la bstan pas kha che'i paṇḍi ta zhig na re/ siṅga la yi yi ger 'dug zer nas yul der byon pa dang sgra rang shugs kyis shes par gyur pas bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung sngar bla mas gnang ba dang sgros gcig par gyur pas lhag pa'i lhas gnang bar go ste bod du spyan drangs/ de nas bod skad du bsgyur/ bla mas gnang ba'i sgrub thabs rnams kyang yi ger btab ste bod du phebs nas/ gro bo lung du gsang sgrub dngos kyi zhal gdams la sogs zhal gdams bco lnga par grags pa bla ma dang mkha' 'gros ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin zin bris su mdzad nas sras kyi thu bo mi la bzhad pa rdo rje la thun mong gi bskyed rdzogs rnams dngos su gnang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag kha cig shog dril du byas te phyag rgyas btab nas/ khyod la ma 'ongs pa na rtsa rlung gi gegs shig 'ong bas de dus ltos shig gsungs nas gnang ba yin te/ rje btsun gyis/ yi dam gang yin zer tsa na// yi dam phag mo dmar chung yin// yi dam mi ngan yi dam bzang*// zhes gsungs pa bzhin thugs dam gyi rtsa ba gsang ba'i yi dam mdzad pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes shing*/ des rgyal bas lung bstan pa dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu la dang po sna len gyi chos su me long sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten te dbang bskur nas bskyed rim lhan cig skyes ma yi dam du gnang*/ rdzogs rim ni nga la sgom skyed dka' bar byung yang 'di la brten nas skyes/ khyod la yang rtogs pa 'phel 'grib 'byung bas de'i tshe 'di dgos gsungs nas skyel thung gi sar gnang zhing nyams su bzhes pas chos sku dngos su gzigs te skal ldan gyi skyes bu mtha' yas pa smin grol du mdzad/

des sangs rgyas drug pa seng ge'i rnam 'phrul rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la gnang nas/ bu khyod sgrub pa khams kyi kaṃ po gangs rar gyis// 'gro don dbus gtsang khams gsum khyab par 'byung*// zhes lung bstan pa bzhin bskyed rdzogs 'di gnyis la brten nas mchog gi rtogs pa mthar phyin te sprul pa'i sku rgyun mi chad par byin gyis brlabs shing dngul chu bai ro las kyang lha snga ma'i dbang bskur zhus nas brgyud pa gnyis 'dres su mdzad/ des ras chen bsod nams grags pa la gnang*/ de nas rim bzhin spom brag pa bsod nams rdo rje/ grub chen karma pakshi/ mkhas gru o rgyan pa/ sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje/ rgyal ba g.yung ston pa/ chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje nas/ drung mkha' spyod dbang po'i bar du gcig brgyud du gnang*/ gdams ngag rnams snyan brgyud du yod pa rje de nyid la lhag pa'i lhas bka'i gnang ba nod de/ gdams ngag rnams yi ger bkod/ gzhung rnams 'thor sdud mdzad de drung de bzhin gshegs pa la gnang*/ de yis sog dbon rig pa'i ral gri dang*/ sprul sku chos dpal ye shes la gnang*/ de gnyis ka'i drung nas rje mthong ba don ldan gyis gsan te sgrub thabs dkyil chog nyi zla ltar grags pa 'di nyid mdzad/ de nas kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po/ gau shrī dpal 'byor don grub/ rje btsun chos grags rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa grub thob/ 'jigs bral mi bskyod rdo rje/ rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag /rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje/ gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug /rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje/ grub mchog ye shes snying po/ mtshungs med ye shes rdo rje/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rje/ 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyin byed/ rgyal ba'i dbang po zhwa nag cod pan 'dzin pa rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i drung nas kho bos thob pa yin la/

brgyud pa'i bla ma de rnams kyang lhag pa'i lha 'di'i bskyed rdzogs kyi sgo nas nges par grub pa brnyes pa'i byin rlabs don gyi brgyud pa khyad par 'phags pa kho na las gzhan du ma gyur cing brgyud pa de las byung pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje btsun mo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la slob dpon gyi bya ba 'os pa'i bdag mdun bum pa bsgrub shing bdag nyid 'jug pa dang bcas pa grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa sngon 'gro sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/

zhes maṇḍal phul bcug / de nas thal mo me tog dang bcas pa'i snyim pa sbyar nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag ni 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyes// 'jig rten bya ba thams cad spangs nas ni// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog 'jug 'dod na// dam pas bdag ni nges par gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags kyi zag med bde ba chen po la 'dod pa'i blos rdo rje slob dpon la dga' chen zhes bos te/ khyod ni bdag gi 'dren pa mchog tu bzung lags pas de'i phyir/ mgon po chen po byang chub chen po'i tshul ston par mdzad pa po khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bdag la gsang sngags kyi dam tshig rnams dang*/ smon 'jug dang*/ kun rdzob dang*/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang*/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun te skyabs gsum rnams stsol zhig /bdag thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog tu gzhug par gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// lan gsum/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i drung du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba bcas lnga rnam par dag pa mdzad snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// byang chub sems su 'di bgyid de// bdag dang gzhan don rab bsgrub phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// e ma ho sems can kun mgron gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzod bzhin spyad// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog

/ lan gsum/ sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas rgyud sbyang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob ma/ bighnanta kṛta kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga yod pa/ rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ 'bru gsum brjod bzhin dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum dri chus byugs la rdo rjes reg cing*/ oṃ ā hūm̐ dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de dag gi 'od zer gyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib bsal nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab par sgoms shig /de ltar sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs nas me tog la sogs pas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye sa mchod/ gnas rnams su rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo gnyis gshibs te brkyang pa rdo rje'i phyag rgyas reg la/ de nas go cha'i lha rnams bkod nas bsrung ba'i don du khyed rang rnams kyi/ lte bar phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ pam̐ dmar po/ snying gar gshin rje ma'i ngo bo haṃ yaṃ sngon mo/ kha la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ maṃ dkar mo/ mgo bor skyed byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ hriṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu/ smin mtshams su gtum mo'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud kha ste/ go cha'i dpa' mo drug gis bsrung ba'o// des sngon 'gro sta gon gyi chos rnams song nas/ sngon 'gro la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇḍal phul/

de nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lan gsum/ de yang bla ma ni dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bo dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas yi dam gyi lha dang dbyer med du go bar gyis shig /ces gdams pa ni/ bla ma dang ni yi dam lha// tha dad du ni ma lta zhig /nges par dngos grub dam pa 'di// bdag gis khyod la sbyin par bya// sngon chad rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir ma zhugs pa'am ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bcas pa mtshon pa'i phyir ras yugs dmar po kha tshar ma nyams pa re gdong g.yogs bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tsakṣū bhandha wā ra mā ṇa ye hūm̐/ zhes gdong g.yogs bcings/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong par dkyil 'khor mjal du mi rung bas de'i phyag rten gyi dod dang*/ mthar thug bral smin gyi yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi la dbang ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i phyir/ trām̐ las byung ba'i rin po che me tog gi phreng ba phyag tu 'dzin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ me tog gtad/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gzhung bzhin btang*/ srung 'khor mtshams bcad bya/ de nas thun mong min pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis bskyed pa ni/ brtag gnyis las/ kun rdzob don dam gzugs can gyi// byang chub sems gnyis rab tu bskyed// kun rdzob kunda lta bu la// don dam bde ba'i gzugs can no// zhes gsungs pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od zer dang bcas pa gsal bar dmigs la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa dā yā mi/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/

sems bskyed pa de nyid brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥ siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du sems bskyed pa de brtan par byas so// zhes brjod/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i drung du sngags kyi sdom pa len pa la/ theg pa chen po'i smon 'jug gi sems bskyed gnyis dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ nyes spyod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed de byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gsum dang bcas pa 'dzin pa ni rnam snang gi dam tshig go/ rdo rje thugs/ dril bu gsung*/ phyag rgya sku ste dam tshig gsum 'dzin cing*/ rdo rje slob dpon la bsnyen bkur bya ba ni rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig go// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag par sbyin pa dang*/ nyin mtshan dus drug gam gsum du sbyin pa ni rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig go// phyi nyan thos/ nang theg chen/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig yang dag par 'dzin pas rang rang gi tshangs spyod bsten pa ni padma'i rigs kyi dam tshig go/ mchod bstod dang*/ las rab 'byams bsgrub pa dang*/ theg pa thams cad kyi sdom pa dang*/ las la mkhas pas 'gro ba 'dul ba las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig go// mdor na rdo rje theg pa'i dngos grub gyi rgyud de dag la gnas pas ngan 'gro rnams ngan 'gro las bsgral bar bya zhing*/ lha mi rnams rgyud grol bar byed pa dang*/ lam dman par zhugs pa rnams theg pa chen por dbugs 'byin par bya ste/ sems can thams cad kyang bdag gis byang chub chen por 'god par bya'o zhes snying stobs chen pos dam bca' zhing de lta bur smon pa'o// de ltar rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyis bsdus pa'i dam tshig thams cad tshul bzhin 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mgon po sangs rgyas rnams dang ni// sras bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/

dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge bdun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa// sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni bzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// lan gsum/ de nas gsang ba mi bsgrag pa'i phyir phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ mgo bor rdo rje bzhag / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// nga yis ye shes rdo rje sbyin// byin pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur// gang zhig 'di 'dra ma mthong ba'i// mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /gal te smras na nyams par 'gyur// de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni// bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par gyis// de nas slar yang 'gal na nyes dmigs bstan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma khyod deng*// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// phan yon dang nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/

bdud rtsi byin la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ badzra ḍā ki ni a mṛ to da ka ṭhā/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ dus 'di nas ni bu khyod kyi// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa// khyod kyis skyo ba med par sgrubs// gang yang nga la ma gus min// de bzhin gus par ma byas na// bdud kyis bcom nas ngan 'gror 'gro// de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis// bdud rtsi lngas byugs pa'i maṇḍal chos 'byung padma me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa slob ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa la/ slob ma rnams bzhag la/ khyed rang rnams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing byin dbab pa'i slad du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes bdag la myur du dbab par mdzad du gsol/

de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu'ang smin par mdzad du gsol/ ces lan gsum mam gcig / de nas khyed rang rnams skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis langs te spyi bor chos 'byung gi phyag rgya 'ching bzhin du dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ de'i steng du skad cig gis khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal ba'i lte bar me rab tu 'bar ba'i chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus na hrīḥlas sngags phreng g.yon du drag tu 'khor ba de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdul tshon dang me long dang*/ o rgyan nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ sngags 'khor dang khyed rang rnams la thim/ gu gul dang tshil chen bsreg /ḍā ma ru'i sgra 'khrol zhing*/ slar yang sngags 'khor las 'od zer dang dga' 'khyil 'phros/ smin mtshams su g.yon du drag tu 'khor/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i byang sems spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya āḥ.aḥ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥpheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ de ltar phab pa'i ye shes pa de nyid ngo sprad pa'i phyir rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang grub pa med// grub pa med pa'i sems nyid 'di// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// snang tsam nyid nas sems su 'dus// sems can kun gyi sems nyid de// bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin// rnam par mi rtog bsam mi khyab// gsal ba de yi ngo bor snang*// mos pa du ma'i sems can la// thabs rnams sna tshogs bstan pa ste// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i sbyor ba yis// dpa' bo seṅge bzhin du spyod// bsam gyis mi khyab go 'phang thob// rje btsun ma yi byin rlabs yin// bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni// sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du// skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul yin//

zhes brjod/ de ltar thabs kyi byin dbab pa dang shes rab kyi sems ngo sprad de rdo rje spyi bor bzhag pas zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ye shes de nyid brtan par gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod/ de nas snang ba brtag pa ni/ mig ras kyi 'og nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar snang la ltos la kha dog ji ltar mthong ba smos shig /zhes kha dog gang mthong smra bcug /de ltar bltas pas kha dog dkar po 'dug na zhi ba/ ser po la rgyas pa/ dmar po la dbang*/ ljang khu'am nag po la mngon spyod dam drag po/ kha dog sna tshogs la las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro//

zhes brjod/ khyed rang rnams sngon tshe gang la sbyang ba'i rigs kyi lha skal brtag pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor gyi drung du me tog dor ba la bden pa'i byin rlabs brjod pa ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya// mkha' 'gro'i rigs kyi rim pa bzhin// bsod nams gang yin de bzhin shog /'dis ni dngos grub gang thob pa// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog / ces brjod/ khyed rang rnams la sngar byin pa'i me tog gi phreng ba de nyid mos gus rtse gcig pas gtso mo'i dbu la 'bul ba'i blos sngags 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor du 'dor bar zhu/ badzra ḍā ki ni pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes me tog 'dor bcug /slob dpon gyis me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi gsang mtshan btags/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha de nyid me tog dang dbyer med du spyi bor thim pa'i mos pa mdzod// bcom ldan 'das ma khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rjes su bzung bar mdzod// ces me tog spyi bor bzhag / khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang mig dar lhan cig tu gsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ spyan lnga rnam dag dbye dang mi dbye bral// 'on kyang sna tshogs yangs pa'i spyan dbye bas// chos kun sgrib bral mkhyen cing gzigs pa yi// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob gyur cig / gser gyi thur mas gdong g.yogs bsal te/ o badzra nāe tra a ba ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes brjod/ de nas ye shes lha'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'di la ltos// zhes lta bar bskul nas dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa ngo sprad par bya ste/ de yang chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba'i lhan skyes ye shes de nyid gang 'dul gyi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams su shar ba las/

'dir ni bcom ldan 'das ma dpal rdo rje btsun mo'i dkyil 'khor te/ chos nyid spros bral la spros pa'i mtshan ma gang gis kyang dbyen spyo bar mi nus pa mtshon pa'i phyir srung ba'i 'khor lo/ de'i nang du bdag med pa mtshon pa'i phyir dur khrod brgyad/ de'i dbus su 'khor ba dag pa'i chos 'byung gdan thabs kyi steng du myang 'das dag pa'i chos 'byung khang thabs/ de'ang srid par gnas kyang srid pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rgyas pa'i phyir gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon pa'i zur gsum pa/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i phyir phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i dbus su gtso mo bcom ldan 'das ma nyid ni/ chos thams cad chos sku gcig pa'i zhal gcig dang*/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i phyag gnyis kyis gri thod 'dzin pa/ yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i kha ṭwām̐ ga mchan du bcug pa bcu drug gi lang tsho nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ dus gsum la mkhyen pa'i spyan gsum mnga' zhing*/ bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra gyen brdzes rigs bdag lnga mtshon thod skam gyi phreng bas bcings pa/ phar phyin drug ldan phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ 'du byed rnam dag thod rlon gyi do shal/ me tog gi phreng ba dang dril bu g.yer kha rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ srid zhi'i mtha' las grol phyir zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum padma ro dang nyi ma'i gdan la gar stabs su bzhugs pa de'i shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma/ nub tu padma mkha' 'gro ma/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ste/ phung po lnga khams lnga 'byung ba lnga sogs lnga tshan du byas pa'i chos rnams rnam par dag pa ye shes lnga dang*/ dbang po lnga dang*/ stobs lnga sogs 'bras bu lnga tshan du byas pa rnams kyi ngo bo lha lngar snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/

da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyed ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlobs// 'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kun// dngos grub thams cad 'di las 'byung*// dam tshig thams cad skyong ba dang*// gsang sngags 'di la brtson par gyis// des 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇḍal phul nas/ de nas rje btsun lho brag pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rgyun mdzad ma dang*/ lhan cig skyes ma dang khams gsum ma rnams su dbang bzhi'i cho ga gsungs pa dang*/ gzhung drug gi zhal gdams 'grel ba'i yig cha sha ba ri'i dbang chog rnams las byung ba ltar/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ tshig dbang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang rjes su gnang ba bcas drug tu yod pa las/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gtso mo tha dad med pa'i drung du dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhu ba'i don du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi sku gsung thugs zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur du gsol/ lha mo dpal gyi blo gros kyis// bir wa pa la dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyod kyis kyang*// bdag sogs dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams la// mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bsgrub slad du// dbang bskur dam pa bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ dang po bum pa'i dbang la chu dang co pan rdo rje dril bu ming dbang ste rigs pa'i dbang lnga/ de'ang gzhi phung po lnga gdod ma nas rgyal ba rigs lngar bzhugs pa la/ de ltar ma rig pa'i gdul bya rnams dbang lnga bskur nas gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin rig par byed pas rig pa'i dbang lnga zhes bya'o// de la mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang sogs thams cad la/

slob dpon gyis dbang lha spyan drangs nas dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod bzhin par bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba dang*/ phyag mtshan byin nas dbang don ngo sprad pa dang*/ spyan drangs pa'i dbang lha slob ma'i lus la zhugs zhing rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan pa ste drug tu shes par bya ba'i dang po mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang gi don du/ slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin bdud rtsi byang sems kyis bkang ba'i bum pa dang thod pa bzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ slob ma la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ slob ma'i spyi bor bum pa bzhag /sangs rgyas kun gyi bum pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// bum pa'i dbang ni khyod la bskur// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ rdo rje lag tu gtad cing*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhe sdang rnam dag pa// rnam shes gnas gyur me long ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi thugs su grol gyur cig /ha oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs te/ bum chu gtor zhing bkrus la blugs// dri ma phung po nyon mongs dag /sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob// mgo bor chu las mi bskyod pa'o// de nas rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang gi don du/

slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs bzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ slob ma la dbang bskur ba mdzad du gsol/ cod pan thogs la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dbu rgyan dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// dbu rgyan dbang ni khyod la bskur// ji ltar bltams pa sogs rin po che lag tu gtad cing*/ rin chen mkha' 'gro nga rgyal rnam dag pa// tshor ba gnas 'gyur mnyam nyid ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi yon tan rdzogs gyur cig /ri oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la gzhug ste// bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blugs// dri ma phung po nyon mongs dag /sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob// mgo bor chu las rin 'byung ngo*// de nas 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang gi don du/ slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rtse mo dgu pa'i rdo rje bzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ slob ma la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje thogs la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje'i dbang ni khyod la bskur// ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ padma lag tu gtad de/ padma mkha' 'gro 'dod chags rnam dag pa// 'du shes gnas 'gyur sor rtog ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi gsung du 'grub gyur cig /ni oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/

dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs te/ bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blugs// dri ma phung po nyon mongs dag /sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob// mgo bo chu las 'od dpag med// de nas don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang gi don du/ slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin sgra grags bzhin pa'i dril bu bzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ slob ma la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ dril bu thogs la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// dril bu'i dbang ni khyod la bskur// ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ ral gri lag tu gtad de/ las kyi mkha' 'gro phrag dog rnam dag pa// 'du byed gnas 'gyur bya grub ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi phrin las rdzogs gyur cig /sa oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs te/ bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blugs// dri ma phung po nyon mongs dag /sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob// mgo bor chu las don grub bo// de nas rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang bskur ba'i don du/ slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ slob ma la dbang bskur du gsol// mgo thog tu rdo rje dril bu mnyam du bzung la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// ming gi dbang ni khyod la bskur// rgyas par gsang mtshan gang yin so sor brjod/

bsdu na spyi khyab la/ kye dpal snang mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ gri gug lag tu gtad la/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gti mug rnam dag pa// gzugs phung gnas 'gyur chos dbyings ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi sku ni 'grub gyur cig /hrīḥ.oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs te/ bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blugs// dri ma phung po nyon mongs dag /sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob/ mgo bor chu las rnam snang ngo*// de ltar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rigs pa'i dbang lnga ste/ lus la bum pa'i dbang bskur bas lus kyi sgrib pa dag nas lam bskyed pa'i rim pa snang stong dbyer med bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// de lta bu'i rigs pa'i dbang lnga bskur/ phung po lnga'i ma dag pa sbyangs nas rigs lngar ngo sprad de snod bcu rigs lngar shes nas tha mal du blta ba dang bral ba ni bum dbang thob pa'i yon tan te/ lus dkyil blta ba dang*/ gsang ba'i dam rdzas len pa sogs la mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa mi skye bas gsang dbang bskur rung du smin pa'o// de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa snyoms 'jug gi sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kar zhu/ sbyor mtshams nas babs pa'i bdud rtsi dang*/ sngar nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byang sems thod par gnas pas spyi bor dbang bskur bar gyur/ thod pa spyi bo dang mgrin par bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thod pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// gsang ba'i dbang ni khyod la bskur/

oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi 'thung du gzhug / byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi de rtsa 'khor lo bzhi la brgyud/ lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad bde ba chen pos khyab par sgoms shig /de ltar bla ma yab yum gyi lus dkyil la brten nas ngag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas/ lam rtsa rlung thig le rdzogs pa'i sgyu lus gsal stong dbyer med bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// de lta bu'i gsang dbang bskur bas sgo gsum byin gyis brlab nas gsal stong gi dga' bde khyad par can du byas pa rgyud la skyes te dbyibs la lha sku blta ba'i zhen pa dang bral ba ni gsang dbang thob pa ste/ 'dod chags kyi rtog pas 'ching bar mi nus shing*/ lam dang lam ma yin pa shes pas shes rab ma'i brtul zhugs len pa la mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa mi skye bas dbang gsum pa bskur rung du smin pa'o// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sindhu ra'i me long slob ma'i lte bar bzhag cing*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi me long dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// shes rab ye shes dbang ni khyod la bskur// oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ me long gi dkyil 'khor las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'phros/ slob ma'i lte bar zhugs/ rlung bzung bas dkyil 'khor de las dmar cha shes rab ye shes kyi me 'bar bas spyi bor ham̐ yig zhu nas rtsa 'khor lo bzhi la brgyud/ lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas sems la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas sems kyi sgrib pa dag nas lam dga' bzhi'i ye shes 'od gsal bde stong dbyer med bsgom pa la dbang*/

'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// de lta bu'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa rnams bde bar byin gyis brlab nas/ chos thams cad bde stong rang rig pa'i ngo bo ro gcig par shes pa ni dbang gsum pa thob ste chos thams cad gdod ma nas dag par bstan pa la mi zhum zhing khong du chud par 'gyur bas dbang bzhi pa bskur rung du smin pa'o// de nas bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che bskur ba ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas mchog nas// byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'i blo gros bzhugs// zhes smos pa na/ khyod rnams kyi yid la gnas dang gang zag gi rnam par blo yul du 'char yang*/ de ni ming tsam brda' tsam btags pa tsam las don la grub pa med do// de ltar drug pa yid kyi yul du snang ba'i gzugs sgra la sogs pa'i chos thams cad dngos po de nyid du ma grub/ khyed rang gi sems nyid gzhi med rtsa bral spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'o// sna tshogs su snang yang snang sems gnyis med chos kyi sku ngos bzung med par ngo shes par gyis shig /

zhes cung zad mnyam par 'jog bcug / de ltar snang srid phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas lus ngag yid gsum la bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa mtha' dag dag /lam 'od gsal zung 'jug rig stong dbyer med phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku gsum dbyer med dam ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// de lta bu'i dbang bzhi pa bskur bas rig stong dang bde stong du 'dzin pa dag ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin don dam pa brjod med kyi ye shes mngon du mthong nas the tshom gyi 'ching ba chad pa ni dbang bzhi pa thob pa ste/ dbang don rtse gcig tu bsgom pa ni grol byed kyi lam yin la/ smin grol de gnyis kyi sgo nas mchog gi dngos po yang dag par grub pa na rdo rje'i slob dpon nyid du bkas gnang ba'i dbang bskur te chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur ba yin no// zhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang mtha' rten rjes gnang bcas zhu ba'i ched du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos bdag la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang rjes gnang bstsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de yang slob dpon gyi dbang la/ dbang bzhi legs par bskur te rgyud bzhi smin pa/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi dpal/ sgo gsum mi shigs pa'i byang sems mchog gi byin brlabs te nus pa mchog tu rgyas pa/ bla med kyi dbang bskur rgyud bshad pa/ de dang 'brel ba'i las ston pa sogs byed pa'i rdo rje mi phyed pa'i mi shigs pa stobs su gyur pa'i slob dpon te/ de ltar phyir mi ldog pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob ma rnams pad nyi la ham̐ dang rdo rje las rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog sngon mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha spyan drangs pa rnams kyis bum pas dbang bskur bar gyur/ bum pa thogs la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du zhugs shing spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ me tog gtor zhing*/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni/ rdo rje lag g.yas su gtad la/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje thabs de kho na nyid kyi rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig tu zungs shig / dril bu g.yon du sbyin la/ āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu shes rab de kho na nyid kyi dril bu gsung gi dam tshig tu zungs shig / 'khyud pa'i tshul byed du bcug la/ 'khyud pas yum dang bcas pa sbyor ba kha sbyor gyi rim pas phyag rgya sku yi dam tshig tu zungs shig / yang rdor dril gtad la/ rdo rje dang ni dril bu longs// shes rab lag pas yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam par sbyor// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa yin no// dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ slob ma bsdu bar gyis shig / ces brjod/ 'di ni dam tshig gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// de nas rjes gnang gi rim pa la/ thog mar bla ma bsgom pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ spyi bor sindhu ra byugs la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang spyi gtsug tu mi 'bral bar sgoms shig /gnyis pa yi dam bsgom pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ sindhu ra lte bar byugs shing*/ khyod kyi lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pas rtag tu mi 'bral bar lus sems rdo rje rnal 'byor mar sgoms shig

/gsum pa sngags bzla ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ rdo rje btsun mos gsang sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phreng ba gtad la/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ sindhu ra mgrin par byugs la/ bzlas pa'i rim pa rnams dang ma bral bar gyis shig /de ni sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'o// zhes dang*/ de nas dam tshig dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ las bzhi'i rjes su gnang ba ni rim pa bzhin du 'di ltar gsan pas khyab par gda'/ rigs lnga mkha' 'gro phyi nang gi// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams// khyod kyis legs par bsrung bar gyis// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// bla ma la gus spyi bor bkur// sems can rnams la byams pa sgom// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la spyad// rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin bsgom// padma mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// phyag rgya brten zhing bde ba bsgom// me mchod 'bul zhing glu gar bya// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// rgyud la gang skyes shes pa rnams// mi dgag thad kar spyod par bya// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen bya// chags zhen spangs la ri khrod 'grim// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i// mchod pa du mas yang dag mchod// ya nga mi bya tshad gzung med// rig pa ngar dang bcas pa yis// mi phod brdzi zhing zhen pa bzlog /'khri ba btsan thabs dag tu bcad// brtul zhugs thug phrad lam du khyer// gcer bu stag gi sham thabs bya// phyag rgya lngas brgyan cang te'u dang*// dril bu sil sil tshangs skud dang*// thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ thogs// dur khrod kun tu rgyu bya ste// rig pa brtul zhugs spyod par gyis// bsrung ba sbyin sreg phyir bzlog sogs// phrin las rab 'byams bsgrub par byos// zhes bsgo/ de ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par grub pas de dag gi skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams legs par bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇḍal phul/ lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa ltos med du 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum/ de ltar dbang bskur ba thob pa la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub par mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ tshogs la rol/ lhag ma rjes chog bkra shis sogs gzhung ltar bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa'i btsas su lhag par dmigs pa'i bsam sbyor gyis kun nas bslangs te/ si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
